summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine share repurchases under its buy-back program announced on 5 August 2026. On 2 September 2026, HSBC purchased 10,000 shares on UK venues and 358,400 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange for cancellation. Total consideration since program commencement is US$518.1 million for 25,166,214 shares. Shares were bought from BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC. This is a routine capital return transaction, not a special situation, as it is an ongoing buy-back program with no premium, tender offer, or strategic event.
